data.name: Upesh
data.gender_notes: Upesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Upa' meaning 'near' and 'Esh' meaning 'god', Upesh signifies 'rising above' and is often given to a child who is expected to excel in all aspects of life. It also symbolizes the child's close connection with the divine. The name Upesh carries the meaning “Rising Above” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Upesh usually hope their child will grow to embody rising above and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a deep connection with the divine and the inner self.
data.etymology: Upesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rising Above.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Upesh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
